d5Dashboard.checklist.title: Ready to go live
d5Dashboard.checklist.progress: {done} of {total, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} done
d5Dashboard.checklist.support: Support is on from your first stream. There's no follower count to reach.
d5Dashboard.step.channel_profile.title: Set up your channel
d5Dashboard.step.channel_profile.hint: Add a picture and a line about what you stream. It shows on your channel page and in search.
d5Dashboard.step.channel_profile.summary: Your channel has a picture or a description.
d5Dashboard.step.stream_info.title: Name your first stream
d5Dashboard.step.stream_info.hint: A title and a category help people find you.
d5Dashboard.step.stream_info.summary: Your stream has a title and a category.
d5Dashboard.step.stream_key.title: Copy your stream key
d5Dashboard.step.stream_key.hint: Paste it into OBS or your encoder. Keep it private: anyone with it can stream as you.
d5Dashboard.step.encoder_connected.title: Connect your encoder
d5Dashboard.step.encoder_connected.hint: Start streaming from OBS. This step ticks itself when we see your signal.
d5Dashboard.step.encoder_connected.waiti: Waiting for your encoder… Start streaming in OBS with the server address and key above.
d5Dashboard.step.encoder_connected.slow: Still nothing after a minute? Check the key, then the server address. A firewall can block the port too.
d5Dashboard.step.rehearsal.title: Do a rehearsal
d5Dashboard.step.rehearsal.hint: Go live privately to check sound and picture. Only you and people you invite can watch.
d5Dashboard.step.first_live.title: Go live
d5Dashboard.step.first_live.hint: Viewers can support you from your first stream. There's no follower count to reach.
d5Dashboard.step.first_live.how: Press Start Streaming in your encoder
d5Dashboard.step.import_twitch.title: Bring your Twitch channel
d5Dashboard.step.import_twitch.hint: Copy your profile, panels and links. We only read from Twitch; nothing changes there.
d5Dashboard.step.bring_your_audience.hin: Share your channel where your viewers already are. A follow link counts who follows you through it.
d5Dashboard.audience.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
d5Dashboard.audience.createFailed: The follow link wasn't made. Try again.
d5Dashboard.audience.followOnce: Shown once. Pin it in your other channel's panels and chat; one tap follows you here.
d5Dashboard.audience.follows: {count, plural, =0 {No follows through your links yet.} one {# follow through your links so far.} other {# follows through your links so far.}}
d5Dashboard.audience.markFailed: That didn't save. Your links are still here; try again.
d5Dashboard.key.label: Stream key
d5Dashboard.key.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Reveal the value and copy it yourself.
d5Dashboard.key.once: Shown once. You can replace it any time in stream settings.
d5Dashboard.key.createFailed: The stream key wasn't created. Try again.
d5Dashboard.guide.label: Encoder
d5Dashboard.guide.obs.1: In OBS, open Settings › Stream and set Service to Custom…
d5Dashboard.guide.obs.2: Paste the server URL and your stream key.
d5Dashboard.guide.obs.3: In Output, use the settings below, or import our profile.
d5Dashboard.guide.streamlabs.1: Open Settings › Stream and set Stream Type to Custom Ingest.
d5Dashboard.guide.streamlabs.2: Paste the server URL and your stream key.
d5Dashboard.guide.larix.1: In Larix, open Connections and add a new connection.
d5Dashboard.guide.larix.2: For the URL, paste the server URL, a slash, then your stream key.
d5Dashboard.guide.whip.hint: For browsers and OBS 30 or later. Use your stream key as the bearer token.
d5Dashboard.guide.downloadFailed: The OBS profile didn't download. Try again.
d5Dashboard.guide.slowUpload: Upload under {upload} Mb/s? Use 720p60 at {kbps60} kb/s, or 720p30 at {kbps30} kb/s.
d5Dashboard.recap.title: Stream recap
d5Dashboard.recap.settling: Viewer numbers aren't final yet. They appear here 24 hours after the stream ends, once every view is checked.
d5Dashboard.recap.settled: Everything above counts verified viewers only.
d5Dashboard.recap.video.processing: Your video is being saved. We'll let you know when it's ready.
d5Dashboard.recap.video.off: This stream wasn't saved. Turn on "Save videos of my streams" to keep the next one.
d5Dashboard.recap.video.failed: This stream's video couldn't be saved.
d5Dashboard.recap.comeBack.title: Tell followers when you're back
d5Dashboard.recap.comeBack.body: Followers who turned on alerts hear the moment you go live again. Mention your next stream before you end this one, or in your channel description.
d5Dashboard.member.title: You're a member-owner now
d5Dashboard.member.body: Your streaming hours made you a member of the co-op. You can vote on proposals and stand for the council.
d5Dashboard.member.action: See what's open for a vote
d5Dashboard.step.get_paid.title: Get paid
d5Dashboard.step.get_paid.hint: Add your payout details so your earnings can reach you.
d5Dashboard.step.get_paid.summary: Your payout details are set up.
